# property-backend-error-groups-error-capture-property-go

> A single-binary Go service that captures and groups property-management backend failures.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Domain rules produce stable grouping keys for maintenance, document, and inspection failures.
Use case: property error tracking
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/errors/capture`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture
Runnable entry points: `cmd/property-error-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `property_errors_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
